record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare MOON_DREAM: Munna (1 star) and Musharna (2 stars). The strategy is shared; the values are indexed by the casting unit's stars. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Gives a shield to the 3 allies nearest to the caster's current target (the caster itself is excluded) and puts that target to sleep. Requested shield per ally: 10 / 20 / 30 / 60 by caster stars (1 / 2 / 3 / 4), i.e. 10 for Munna and 20 for Musharna, raw; it is then scaled by x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1) and, if the cast crit, x critPower (crit needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false); the applied shield also changes with a Big Eater Belt on the recipient (raw value x1.25 rounded down, applied before the AP/crit factors), halves on an enraged recipient and is rounded. Requested sleep on the target: 3000 / 6000 / 9000 / 18000 ms by caster stars (3000 ms Munna, 6000 ms Musharna) with NO AP or crit factor in the strategy; Status.triggerSleep then applies guards and duration changes (night x1.3, zenith x0.7, enraged target /2, water-ability and Odd Keystone reductions). No damage is dealt.

targeting.who: sleep: the caster's current target (the strategy receives it as the target argument; requiresTarget is the default true). shield: up to 3 own-team units other than the caster, nearest by Manhattan distance to the cell (targetX, targetY) the caster is attacking
targeting.note: The allies are sorted by distance to the caster's targetX/targetY, which AttackingState sets to the target cell before the cast, not by distance to the caster. board.cells is row-major and Array.sort is stable, so equal-distance allies keep row-major order. If fewer than 3 other allies are on the board all of them are shielded; if there are none only the sleep happens.

geometry.shape: no area: up to 3 allies anywhere on the board (selected by distance to the enemy target) plus the single target; no range limit on the ally selection

effects.target: the 3 allies nearest to the caster's target (not the caster)

declaredRaw.label: raw shield by caster stars before AP, crit, Big Eater Belt, enrage

effects.scaling: requested raw = table value (10 Munna / 20 Musharna). Applied = round(beltAdjusted x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1) x (recipient enraged ? 0.5 : 1)), where beltAdjusted = raw x1.25 rounded down if the recipient holds a Big Eater Belt (applied to the raw value in PokemonEntity.addShield before the AP step), else raw. AP is the caster's. At 0 AP, no crit, no belt, no enrage: 10 (Munna) / 20 (Musharna).
effects.resolution: added to the recipient's existing shield with no cap, only if the recipient has hp > 0; the shield amount is credited to the caster's shieldDone. Three amounts kept apart: requested = table value; applied = shield actually added after helper, AP, crit and enrage; this is not damage so handleDamage/takenDamage does not apply.

effects.scaling: no AP or crit factor in the strategy (unlike HYPNOSIS): requested = table value, 3000 ms Munna / 6000 ms Musharna
effects.resolution: see statusEffects.0: applied only if the guards pass, then weather / enrage / reduction changes

declaredRaw.label: sleep duration (ms), no AP/crit factor in the strategy

statusEffects.scaling: requested duration = table value by caster stars; triggerSleep is called with the target as pkm and applies no AP scaling; the caster's AP and crit do not change the sleep
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied only if the target is not already asleep, has no rune protect, is not skydiving, has no IMMUNITY_SLEEP effect and ccCooldown is 0 (CC_COOLDOWN 1500 ms starts when a sleep ends). Applied duration = round(requested x 1.3 at night or x0.7 at zenith, /2 if the target is enraged, then SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 / HYDRATION x0.5 / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then x(1 - 0.1 per Odd Keystone)). A Chesto Berry holder eats the berry when the sleep is applied (its own effect not traced). Becoming enraged halves the remaining sleep. A sleeping unit cannot move or attack (except COMATOSE) and cannot dodge attacks.

shields.target: 3 nearest allies to the caster's target, excluding the caster

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars (fallback to the 4-star value). The listed units are catalog stars 1 and 2. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Ally selection depends on distance to the enemy target cell, not the caster. With no other ally on the board no shield is given; the sleep still applies to the target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. Re-casting on a target that is still asleep does not extend the sleep (guard) and ccCooldown protects it for CC_COOLDOWN after waking. Shields stack onto existing shield with no cap; the nearest allies are re-evaluated each cast.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: shield 10 (Munna) / 20 (Musharna) raw to up to 3 allies, sleep 3000 / 6000 ms. Applied: shield after Big Eater Belt (x1.25 down, on the raw value), AP factor, crit factor and enrage halving, rounded; sleep after the triggerSleep guards and weather / enrage / reduction changes. No damage, so no takenDamage.

Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
The Chesto Berry effect (eatBerry) was not traced

Whether the caster's targetX/targetY can be stale or -1 at cast time (setTarget in pokemon-entity.ts sets them; not traced further)
Whether the listed units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
